papers.title: Diversification without convergence: national childhood respiratory pathogen spectra diverge as they diversify, 1990-2023
papers.translated_title: 无趋同的多样化：1990-2023年各国儿童呼吸道病原体谱在多样化过程中出现分化
papers.author: Li, D.
papers.summary: Background National childhood respiratory pathogen spectra are diversifying nearly everywhere - within-country diversity rose in 203 of 204 countries between 1990 and 2023 - yet whether countries are diversifying toward a common spectrum or along divergent paths is unknown. We quantified between-country compositional distance of national pathogen spectra over the same period. Methods We built national pathogen share vectors from Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 lower respiratory infection etiologic attributions (26 pathogens, 204 countries, ages 0-19 years) at five timepoints spanning 1990-2023. Between-country distance was measured as all pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergences (JSD; primary) and Bray-Curtis dissimilarities, with Baselga and Jaccard decompositions; robustness was assessed across metrics, pathogen panels, low-count thresholds and a balanced panel of 107 countries. Results Mean pairwise JSD rose from 0.0084 in 1990 to 0.0283 in 2023 (+238%; trend p = 0.030), peaking in 2021 (+283%) with a partial 2023 pullback. Bray-Curtis dissimilarity rose +120% and the balanced panel +423%. Divergence was entirely balanced variation (share reallocation), with spectrum richness rising from 18.5 to 21.1 of 26 pathogens. Dispersion rose fastest for influenza (coefficient of variation 0.03 to 0.55) and respiratory syncytial virus (0.08 to 0.48). Within-region distance rose in every computable GBD super-region (five of seven): divergence occurs within regions, not between blocs. A country-level bootstrap confirmed the increase (+238%, 95% CI +165 to +331), and segmented trend analysis found no supported breakpoint, with divergence proceeding steadily at +4.1% per year (95% CI 2.0-6.3) rather than in stages. Conclusions National spectra are re-sorting along country-specific axes as vaccine-preventable dominance recedes at different speeds. Diversification is universal, but convergence is absent: the transition at the etiologic-spectrum level is asynchronous and path-dependent, with implications for empirical treatment policy and pathogen surveillance.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 各国儿童呼吸道病原体谱几乎都在多样化——1990年至2023年间，204个国家中有203个国家的国内多样性上升——但各国是在向共同谱系多样化，还是沿不同路径分化，尚不清楚。我们量化了同一时期各国病原体谱之间的构成距离。方法 我们基于2023年全球疾病负担研究下呼吸道感染病因归因（26种病原体、204个国家、0-19岁）在1990-2023年间五个时间点构建了国家病原体份额向量。国家间距离以所有成对Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD；主要指标）和Bray-Curtis相异度衡量，并采用Baselga和Jaccard分解；稳健性通过多种指标、病原体面板、低计数阈值以及107个国家的平衡面板进行评估。结果 平均成对JSD从1990年的0.0084上升至2023年的0.0283（+238%；趋势p = 0.030），2021年达到峰值（+283%），2023年部分回落。Bray-Curtis相异度上升+120%，平衡面板上升+423%。分化完全为平衡变异（份额重新分配），谱系丰富度从26种病原体中的18.5升至21.1。离散度上升最快的是流感（变异系数0.03至0.55）和呼吸道合胞病毒（0.08至0.48）。区域内距离在每个可计算的GBD超级区域（七个中的五个）均上升：分化发生在区域内部，而非区块之间。国家层面自助法确认了增加（+238%，95% CI +165至+331），分段趋势分析未发现支持的断点，分化以每年+4.1%（95% CI 2.0-6.3）的速度稳步推进，而非分阶段进行。结论 随着疫苗可预防的 dominance 以不同速度消退，各国病原体谱正沿国家特定轴线重新排序。多样化是普遍的，但趋同缺失：病因谱层面的转变是异步且路径依赖的，这对经验性治疗政策和病原体监测具有启示意义。

papers.title: Avoidable childhood respiratory-infection deaths: a frontier analysis of episode-fatality ratios in 204 countries, 1990-2023
papers.translated_title: 可避免的儿童呼吸道感染死亡：1990-2023年204个国家病死率前沿分析
papers.author: Li, D.
papers.summary: Background Respiratory infections remain the leading infectious cause of death among children and adolescents, yet the share of these deaths that could be averted with currently feasible care is not routinely quantified. Existing amenable-mortality frameworks rely on cause lists and population-level mortality benchmarks and do not exploit information on how many episodes occur. We propose an episode-fatality-ratio (EFR) frontier approach and apply it to lower respiratory infections (LRI), whooping cough (pertussis) and upper respiratory infections (URI) in 204 countries, 1990-2023. Methods For each cause, country and year we computed EFR = deaths/incident episodes using Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 estimates for ages 0-19 years. The frontier was defined as the 10th-percentile country EFR within each GBD super-region, cause and year; avoidable deaths = max(0, deaths - episodes x frontier EFR). Primary estimates are deterministic; 95% uncertainty intervals (UIs) come from 2,000 Monte Carlo draws. Sensitivity analyses varied the frontier percentile, applied an aspirational global frontier, constructed pertussis counterfactuals, and recomputed all estimates within the single under-5 age band. Findings In 2023, 333,803 childhood deaths from lower respiratory infections (95% UI 289,123-417,460; 46.9% of LRI deaths) were avoidable. Summing the three causes deterministically gives 391,034 avoidable deaths (46.5% of 840,444); the combined figure is a deterministic sum, and a UI is available for the LRI component only. The pertussis (43,958; 39.0%) and URI (13,273; 81.0%) estimates are secondary: their deterministic point values fall below their own Monte Carlo intervals and the underlying death estimates carry very wide uncertainty (global pertussis UI 12,545-321,874). Avoidable deaths fell from 1,050,468 (44.9%) in 1990, but between 2019 and 2023 the avoidable share for LRI+URI barely moved (48.7% to 47.7%) while absolute avoidable deaths fell 14.5%, a pattern consistent with stalled convergence to the frontier. Sub-Saharan Africa plus South Asia held 73.1% of avoidable deaths in 2023 versus 41zzz
papers.translated_summary: 背景 呼吸道感染仍是儿童和青少年最主要的感染性死因，但这些死亡中可通过当前可行医疗避免的比例尚未被常规量化。现有的可避免死亡框架依赖死因列表和人群水平死亡率基准，未利用发病例数信息。我们提出一种病例致死比（EFR）前沿方法，并将其应用于1990—2023年204个国家的下呼吸道感染（LRI）、百日咳和上呼吸道感染（URI）。方法 对每一死因、国家和年份，我们使用全球疾病负担（GBD）2023年0—19岁估计值计算EFR=死亡数/发病例数。前沿定义为每个GBD超级区域、死因和年份内第10百分位国家的EFR；可避免死亡=max(0，死亡数-发病例数×前沿EFR)。主要估计为确定性估计；95%不确定性区间（UI）来自2000次蒙特卡洛抽样。敏感性分析改变了前沿百分位、应用理想全球前沿、构建百日咳反事实，并在单一5岁以下年龄组内重新计算所有估计。结果 2023年，333803例儿童下呼吸道感染死亡（95% UI 289123—417460；占LRI死亡的46.9%）为可避免死亡。将三种死因确定性相加得到391034例可避免死亡（占840444例的46.5%）；合计数字为确定性加总，仅LRI部分有可用UI。百日咳（43958例；39.0%）和URI（13273例；81.0%）估计为次要估计：其确定性点值低于各自的蒙特卡洛区间，且 underlying 死亡估计具有很宽的不确定性（全球百日咳UI 12545—321874）。可避免死亡从1990年的1050468例（44.9%）下降，但2019—2023年间LRI+URI的可避免比例几乎未变（48.7%降至47.7%），而绝对可避免死亡下降14.5%，这一模式与向前沿收敛停滞相一致。2023年撒哈拉以南非洲加南亚占可避免死亡的73.1%，而1990年为41zzz

papers.title: Thermal variability and the geography of optimal temperature for child survival: childhood respiratory-infection mortality in 171 countries: a systematic analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 and the C-LSAT high-resolution climate dataset
papers.translated_title: 儿童生存的热变异性与最适温度的地理分布：171个国家儿童呼吸道感染死亡率——基于2023年全球疾病负担研究和C-LSAT高分辨率气候数据集的系统分析
papers.author: Li, D.
papers.summary: Background In adults, cold-attributable mortality exceeds heat-attributable mortality roughly 17-fold. Child-specific evidence has begun to emerge only recently-a nationwide Brazilian case-crossover study located the minimum mortality temperature (MMT) for under-five deaths, and a 56-country survey-based analysis linked monthly temperature anomalies to under-five mortality-but no multi-country, climate-zone-resolved estimate of the childhood respiratory-infection MMT exists, and whether temperature variability is independently associated with childhood respiratory mortality at the global scale is unknown. We quantified both. Methods We combined Global Burden of Disease 2023 mortality estimates-lower respiratory infection (LRI) deaths at ages 0-19 years and asthma deaths at ages 0-24 years, 171 countries, 1990-2023-with 0.5 degree monthly land temperature and diurnal temperature range (DTR) fields from C-LSAT/C-LDTR (1901-2023). Four exposure dimensions (annual mean, DTR, seasonal amplitude, interannual variability) entered two-way fixed-effects models with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors. A quadratic term in mean temperature located the MMT, with percentile confidence intervals from a 300-replication country-cluster bootstrap. Future-exposure leads, country-level detrending, and permutation tests assessed contemporaneous causality, applied to both the linear coefficients and the quadratic term generating the MMT; national pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV3) coverage and ambient PM2.5 exposure series were added as time-varying mechanistic covariates. Country-level exposure changes for 2041-2060 were additionally projected under three CMIP6 SSP scenarios (WorldClim v2.1 baseline; MRI-ESM2-0) using a matched-cell delta method. Results The childhood LRI MMT was 17.1 degrees C (95% CI 14.7-19.8), the 36th percentile of the annual-temperature distribution; zone estimates were 24.7 degrees C in tropical and 15.8 degrees C in subtropical countries, with weak temperate and no subarctic identification. The quadratic term underpinning the MMT, however, failed both falsification checks-future temperatures reproduced the U-shape and country-level detrending erased it-so these MMT values describe a trend-level geographic pattern of the annual construct rather than a contemporaneous dose-response. Interannual temperature variability was positively associated with LRI (+0.278, 95% CI 0.102-0.454; p = 0.002) and asthma mortality (+0.836, 95% CI 0.447-1.226; p = 2.6 x 10-5) per 1 degree C, but future-exposure models returned nearly identical significant coefficients and detrending erased significance, supporting only a trend-level association; adjustment for national PCV3 coverage and PM2.5 exposure left these estimates essentially unchanged. Annual mean temperature was likewise inversely associated with both outcomes at the trend level; DTR and seasonal amplitude showed no independent within-country effects. Under all three scenarios, country-mean annual temperature is projected to rise by +1.6 to +2.4 degrees C by 2041-2060, with seasonal amplitude widening in 77-81% of the 196 projection polygons (a climate-raster set wider than the 171-country mortality panel). Conclusions This study provides the first multi-country, climate-zone-resolved geography of the optimal temperature for childhood respiratory survival, spanning 171 countries; because the underlying quadratic association is trend-level, the estimates are directional. The observed variability-mortality associations are trend-level signals rather than contemporaneous causal evidence; daily-scale, child-specific designs are required to determine whether short-term thermal variability affects paediatric respiratory mortality.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 在成人中，归因于寒冷的死亡率大约超过归因于高温的死亡率17倍。儿童特异性证据直到最近才开始出现——一项巴西全国性病例交叉研究确定了五岁以下儿童死亡的最低死亡温度（MMT），一项基于56个国家调查的分析将月度温度异常与五岁以下儿童死亡率联系起来——但尚不存在多国家、按气候带解析的儿童呼吸道感染MMT估计，且温度变异性是否在全球尺度上与儿童呼吸道死亡率独立相关仍不清楚。我们对两者均进行了量化。方法 我们将全球疾病负担2023年死亡率估计——0-19岁下呼吸道感染（LRI）死亡和0-24岁哮喘死亡，171个国家，1990-2023年——与来自C-LSAT/C-LDTR（1901-2023年）的0.5度月度陆地温度和昼夜温度范围（DTR）场相结合。四个暴露维度（年均值、DTR、季节振幅、年际变异性）进入采用Driscoll-Kraay标准误的双向固定效应模型。平均温度中的二次项用于定位MMT，百分位置信区间来自300次重复的国家聚类自助法。未来暴露前置、国家层面去趋势和置换检验评估同期因果性，应用于线性系数和生成MMT的二次项；国家肺炎球菌结合疫苗（PCV3）覆盖率和环境PM2.5暴露序列作为时变机制协变量加入。此外，使用匹配单元delta方法，在三种CMIP6 SSP情景（WorldClim v2.1基线；MRI-ESM2-0）下预测了2041-2060年国家层面暴露变化。结果 儿童LRI的MMT为17.1摄氏度（95% CI 14.7-19.8），位于年温度分布的第36百分位；各气候带估计为热带国家24.7摄氏度、亚热带国家15.8摄氏度，温带识别较弱，亚寒带无识别。然而，支撑MMT的二次项未能通过两项证伪检验——未来温度重现了U形，国家层面去趋势将其消除——因此这些MMT值描述的是年度构造的趋势层面地理格局，而非同期剂量反应。年际温度变异性与LRI（+0.278，95% CI 0.102-0.454；p = 0.002）和哮喘死亡率（+0.836，95% CI 0.447-1.226；p = 2.6 x 10-5）每1摄氏度呈正相关，但未来暴露模型返回几乎相同的显著系数，去趋势则消除了显著性，仅支持趋势层面关联；对国家PCV3覆盖率和PM2.5暴露的调整使这些估计基本不变。年均温度同样在趋势层面与两种结局呈负相关；DTR和季节振幅未显示独立的国内效应。在三种情景下，预计2041-2060年国家平均年温度将上升+1.6至+2.4摄氏度，196个预测多边形（一个比171个国家死亡率面板更广的气候栅格集）中有77-81%的季节振幅扩大。结论 本研究首次提供了跨越171个国家的、按气候带解析的儿童呼吸道生存最佳温度地理格局；由于 underlying 二次关联为趋势层面，这些估计具有方向性。观察到的变异性-死亡率关联是趋势层面信号，而非同期因果证据；需要日尺度、儿童特异性设计来确定短期热变异性是否影响儿科呼吸道死亡率。

papers.title: Expert-level localization of fine-grained cardiac structures across the transthoracic echocardiogram
papers.translated_title: 经胸超声心动图中心脏精细结构的专家级定位
papers.author: Mahmoudi, E. m.
papers.summary: Artificial intelligence models for echocardiography interpret studies without identifying the structures that support their outputs. We show that this spatial grounding does not emerge from the pretraining of current vision-language models. General-purpose and medical vision-language models and an open-vocabulary detector recalled 3% or fewer of cardiac structures and scored below a box that never sees the image. EchoLens, a detector trained on 5,912 expert-annotated structures and 4,219 Doppler signals from 136 patients, recalled 87% and localized structures as reliably as a blinded expert reader (box centre within the reference in 95.7% and 95.3% of cases). It covers 21 structures across 11 transthoracic views and 11 spectral Doppler signal types. In external data, two physicians judged 81-92% of its detections correct across all 11 views, and it identified the Doppler signal type in 83% of frames. EchoLens provides the spatial layer that grounded echocardiographic interpretation requires.
papers.translated_summary: 用于超声心动图的人工智能模型在解读研究时并不识别支撑其输出的结构。我们表明，这种空间定位并不会从当前视觉语言模型的预训练中涌现。通用和医学视觉语言模型以及一个开放词汇检测器召回的心脏结构不超过3%，并且得分低于一个从未见过图像的边界框。EchoLens是一个在来自136名患者的5,912个专家标注结构和4,219个多普勒信号上训练的检测器，其召回率为87%，并且定位结构的可靠性与一名盲法专家读者相当（在95.7%和95.3%的病例中，边界框中心位于参考范围内）。它覆盖11个经胸视图中的21个结构和11种频谱多普勒信号类型。在外部数据中，两名医生判定其在所有11个视图中的检测结果有81-92%正确，并且它在83%的帧中识别出了多普勒信号类型。EchoLens提供了有依据的超声心动图解读所需的空间层。

papers.title: No convergence in three decades: national trajectories of episode-fatality ratios for childhood lower respiratory infections in 204 countries, 1990-2023
papers.translated_title: 三十年来无趋同：1990-2023年204个国家儿童下呼吸道感染病例致死率的国家轨迹
papers.author: Li, D.
papers.summary: Background Lower respiratory infections (LRI) remain the leading infectious cause of death in children, and survival once ill is a direct tracer of health-system quality. Whether countries are converging toward the best survival performance achieved within their own region has never been tested at national level. We measured each country's distance to an empirical episode-fatality-ratio (EFR) frontier in 204 countries from 1990 to 2023. Methods For each country and year we computed EFR = LRI deaths/incident episodes using Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 estimates for ages 0-19 years. Deaths span the full 1990-2023 series; episodes are observed for 1990, 2019 and 2023, with intermediate years linearly interpolated. The frontier was the 10th-percentile country EFR within each GBD super-region and year (sensitivity: 5th and 25th percentiles); the gap = EFR_country/EFR_frontier. We classified 33-year gap trajectories into catch-up phenotypes, ranked COVID-window (2019-2023) movers, cross-tabulated gap against avoidable deaths to build a priority list, and benchmarked upper respiratory infections (URI) at three time points as a near-zero-fatality contrast. Findings The median country's gap was 1.86 in 1990, 1.80 in 2019 and 1.86 in 2023; the share of countries more than twice their regional frontier was 44.6% in 1990 and 46.6% in 2023. Of 137 eligible countries, 67 narrowed and 69 widened their gap, with one unchanged. Nineteen countries achieved sustained catch-up, concentrated in North Africa and the Middle East (7) and Latin America (5), with China closing from 2.43 to 0.50, below its regional frontier; 28 countries regressed, led by Central Asia (Uzbekistan x3.5) and including the United States (x2.0). Over the COVID-19 window the median gap peaked at 2.00 in 2021 (+10.8% versus 2019, from unrounded medians) before returning to 1.86. Combining gap with avoidable deaths identifies two distinct policy problems: high-burden, moderate-gap giants (Nigeria 67,490 avoidable deaths, gap 2.4; India 54,109, gap 1.6) and extreme-gap outliers (Uzbekistan, gap 28.6). The Sub-Saharan Africa frontier fell further behind the High-income frontier (ratio 4.2 in 1990, 9.5 in 2023); the median Sub-Saharan African country sits 11.0 times the global 10th-percentile frontier but only 1.78 times its own regional frontier, so within-region benchmarking understates the region's true distance. URI gaps likewise did not converge (median 4.15 to 4.60). Joinpoint regression formalized the pattern: the median gap showed no net narrowing over 33 years (average annual percent change +0.03% per year, 95% CI -0.05 to 0.12). Interpretation Convergence toward the survival frontier is not the default national trajectory: over three decades the typical country made no net progress toward the best decile of its own region, and pandemic-era divergence was only partly reversed. National gap trajectories separate system-wide quality shortfalls from extreme outliers warranting audit, and expose a measurement trap in which regions whose frontiers stagnate appear closer to best practice than they are.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 下呼吸道感染（LRI）仍是儿童最主要的感染性死因，患病后的生存情况是卫生系统质量的直接示踪指标。各国是否正在向其所在区域内已实现的最佳生存表现收敛，此前从未在国家层面得到检验。我们测量了1990年至2023年间204个国家各自与经验性病例病死率（EFR）前沿的距离。方法 对每个国家和年份，我们使用全球疾病负担（GBD）2023年0-19岁年龄组的估计值计算EFR = LRI死亡数/发病病例数。死亡数据覆盖完整的1990-2023年序列；发病病例数在1990年、2019年和2023年有观测值，中间年份采用线性插值。前沿定义为每个GBD超级区域和年份内第10百分位国家的EFR（敏感性分析：第5和第25百分位）；差距 = EFR_国家/EFR_前沿。我们将33年差距轨迹分类为追赶表型，对COVID窗口期（2019-2023年）变动国家进行排名，将差距与可避免死亡交叉制表以构建优先清单，并在三个时间点以上呼吸道感染（URI）作为接近零病死率的对照进行基准比较。发现 中位国家的差距1990年为1.86，2019年为1.80，2023年为1.86；差距超过其区域前沿两倍以上的国家占比1990年为44.6%，2023年为46.6%。在137个符合条件的国家中，67个缩小了差距，69个扩大了差距，1个保持不变。19个国家实现了持续追赶，集中在北非和中东（7个）以及拉丁美洲（5个），中国从2.43缩小至0.50，低于其区域前沿；28个国家出现倒退，以中亚为首（乌兹别克斯坦×3.5），其中包括美国（×2.0）。在COVID-19窗口期，中位差距在2021年达到峰值2.00（较2019年+10.8%，基于未四舍五入的中位数），随后回落至1.86。将差距与可避免死亡结合，识别出两类不同的政策问题：高负担、中等差距的巨量国家（尼日利亚67,490例可避免死亡，差距2.4；印度54,109例，差距1.6）和极端差距离群国家（乌兹别克斯坦，差距28.6）。撒哈拉以南非洲前沿与高收入前沿的差距进一步拉大（1990年比值4.2，2023年9.5）；撒哈拉以南非洲中位国家为全球第10百分位前沿的11.0倍，但仅为其自身区域前沿的1.78倍，因此区域内基准比较低估了该区域的真实距离。URI差距同样未收敛（中位数从4.15升至4.60）。Joinpoint回归将这一模式形式化：中位差距在33年间无净缩小（平均年度百分比变化+0.03%/年，95% CI -0.05至0.12）。解释 向生存前沿收敛并非国家的默认轨迹：三十年间，典型国家在向其所在区域最佳十分位追赶方面没有取得净进展，大流行时期的偏离仅部分逆转。国家差距轨迹将系统性的质量短板与需要审计的极端离群国家区分开来，并揭示了一个测量陷阱：前沿停滞的区域看起来比实际更接近最佳实践。

papers.title: Warming, thermal variability, and the 96% decline in childhood respiratory-infection mortality in China: a national time-series analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021 and the C-LSAT high-resolution climate dataset
papers.translated_title: 气候变暖、热变异性与中国儿童呼吸道感染死亡率下降96%：基于2021年全球疾病负担研究和C-LSAT高分辨率气候数据集的全国时间序列分析
papers.author: Li, D.
papers.summary: Background Childhood respiratory mortality in China has fallen by over 90% in three decades alongside sustained national warming, yet national long-run evidence on temperature and child respiratory mortality is lacking. Methods We linked Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 mortality estimates (rates use a fixed 2022 population denominator, so rate trends equal death-count trends) for China - lower respiratory infections (LRI), ages 0-19, and asthma, ages 0-24, 1990-2021 - with C-LSAT 0.5 degree gridded temperature data (1990-2019), aggregated nationally and to five climate zones. Four annual indicators (mean temperature, diurnal temperature range, seasonal amplitude, interannual variability) entered regressions of log mortality rates with Newey-West standard errors. A bootstrapped (500 resamples) quadratic model probed the minimum mortality temperature (MMT), with PM2.5-adjusted analyses and future-exposure, permutation, and detrended falsification tests. Changes in China's national thermal regime for 2041-2060 were additionally projected under three CMIP6 SSP scenarios (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5; WorldClim v2.1 1970-2000 baseline, MRI-ESM2-0) using a matched-cell delta method. Results LRI deaths fell by 96.3% (330,194 in 1990 to 12,098 in 2021; 95% uncertainty interval 9,669-14,891) and asthma deaths by 94.9% (3,287 to 167), while mean temperature rose 0.364 degrees C per decade and diurnal temperature range narrowed 0.092 degrees C per decade. Baseline coefficients were large (mean temperature -1.696, SE 0.174; diurnal temperature range +2.408, SE 0.336; seasonal amplitude -0.162, SE 0.082; interannual variability +2.924, SE 1.514, per 1 degree C in log rate), but the future-exposure test failed and detrending nullified every coefficient: the associations are trend-level, and short-cycle causal effects are not identifiable. Nor was the national MMT identifiable - observed temperature support spans only 6.66-8.13 degrees C, and the nominal turning point of 35.84 degrees C is an extrapolation artifact (quadratic term p = 0.963). Within the observed range, warming and declining mortality moved in the same direction. A CMIP6 scenario projection (WorldClim v2.1, MRI-ESM2-0, matched-cell national means) indicates a further +2.19 to +3.02 degrees C of national warming by 2041-2060, with little change in diurnal temperature range or seasonal amplitude. Conclusions The 96% decline in childhood respiratory mortality cannot be attributed to warming. China sits on the low-temperature side of the optimum, and the marginal direction of future warming requires stronger designs to establish. The falsification framework offers a discipline for climate-health inference in China. Bias-corrected scenario projections place China's 2050s mean temperature (approximately 9.4-10.3 degrees C on the C-LSAT scale) still far below multi-country optima (14.7-19.8 degrees C), noting that an annual-mean construct is not fully comparable with daily-scale MMT estimates.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 中国儿童呼吸道死亡率三十年间下降逾90%，同期全国持续变暖，但缺乏关于气温与儿童呼吸道死亡率的全国长期证据。方法 我们将全球疾病负担（GBD）2021年中国死亡率估计值（率采用固定的2022年人口分母，故率趋势等同于死亡数趋势）——下呼吸道感染（LRI），0-19岁，以及哮喘，0-24岁，1990-2021年——与C-LSAT 0.5度格点气温数据（1990-2019年）相链接，汇总至全国及五个气候区。四项年度指标（平均气温、日温差、季节振幅、年际变率）进入对数死亡率的回归，采用Newey-West标准误。采用自助法（500次重抽样）二次模型探究最低死亡温度（MMT），并进行PM2.5调整分析及未来暴露、置换和去趋势证伪检验。此外，利用匹配格点delta方法，在三种CMIP6 SSP情景（SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5和SSP5-8.5；WorldClim v2.1 1970-2000年基线，MRI-ESM2-0）下预测了2041-2060年中国国家热状况的变化。结果 LRI死亡下降96.3%（1990年330,194例降至2021年12,098例；95%不确定性区间9,669-14,891），哮喘死亡下降94.9%（3,287例降至167例），而平均气温每十年上升0.364摄氏度，日温差每十年收窄0.092摄氏度。基线系数较大（平均气温-1.696，SE 0.174；日温差+2.408，SE 0.336；季节振幅-0.162，SE 0.082；年际变率+2.924，SE 1.514，每1摄氏度对数率），但未来暴露检验未通过，去趋势使所有系数归零：关联为趋势层面，短期周期因果效应不可识别。全国MMT亦不可识别——观测气温支撑范围仅6.66-8.13摄氏度，名义转折点35.84摄氏度系外推伪影（二次项p = 0.963）。在观测范围内，变暖与死亡率下降同向变动。CMIP6情景预测（WorldClim v2.1，MRI-ESM2-0，匹配格点全国均值）表明2041-2060年全国进一步变暖+2.19至+3.02摄氏度，日温差或季节振幅变化甚微。结论 儿童呼吸道死亡率96%的下降不能归因于变暖。中国位于最适温度的低温度侧，未来变暖的边际方向需更强设计方能确立。证伪框架为中国气候-健康推断提供了 discipline。偏差校正的情景预测显示中国2050年代平均气温（按C-LSAT尺度约9.4-10.3摄氏度）仍远低于多国最适温度（14.7-19.8摄氏度），需注意年均值构念与日尺度MMT估计不完全可比。

papers.title: After the vaccine era: sequencing platform investments as the childhood pneumonia spectrum diversifies
papers.translated_title: 疫苗时代之后：测序平台投资与儿童肺炎病原谱多样化
papers.author: Li, D.
papers.summary: Background The historic decline in childhood pneumonia mortality was driven substantially by single-pathogen vaccines against Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) and Streptococcus pneumoniae. Yet the pathogen spectrum underlying child pneumonia deaths is diversifying: the effective number of pathogens rose from 5.57 in 1990 to 9.94 in 2023, and the residual burden is shifting toward opportunistic and hospital-associated pathogens for which no licensed childhood vaccines exist. This paper asks how resources should be sequenced between single-pathogen interventions and platform investments as this transition proceeds. Methods We analyzed Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 deaths from 29 pathogens in ages 0-19 years by super-region, combined with WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC) for PCV3 and Hib3. We quantified the spectrum transition under two denominators (26- and 29-pathogen calibers), constructed a share-by-intervenability matrix assigning each pathogen to a dominant intervention channel (vaccine-reachable, mixed, platform-sensitive) under explicit classification rules, compared platform-sensitive deaths with a transparently computed scenario of residual vaccine-preventable deaths, and cross-classified pathogens by age tropism and poverty lock. We anchored platform interventions to verified published evidence. Results The vaccine-preventable group share fell from 54.0% to 40.2% while the opportunistic/hospital group rose from 18.1% to 23.1% (29-pathogen caliber, 1990-2023). Super-region vaccine coverage showed no significant association with pathogen-share change (PCV3 Spearman rho = 0.108, p = 0.818; Hib3 rho = -0.036, p = 0.939), a null result we report as evidence that simple coverage-burden correlations do not hold at the regional level, not as evidence against vaccine value. In 2023, vaccine-reachable pathogens accounted for 441,410 deaths (45.7%, channel including COVID-19), mixed for 126,926 (13.1%), and platform-sensitive pathogens for 396,995 (41.1%). Platform-sensitive deaths were 2.9-5.1 times the scenario estimate of residual vaccine-preventable deaths (52,435-77,512). Nine of 14 classifiable pathogens fell into the poverty-locked, infant-tropic cell (480,922 deaths; Fisher OR = 9.0, p = 0.1758). Conclusions The marginal value of single-pathogen strategies declines as the spectrum diversifies and residual deaths concentrate in platform-sensitive, poverty-locked, infant-tropic pathogens. Vaccine scale-up remains a certain and sizeable opportunity; the next increment of marginal resources should increasingly fund platform capabilities (oxygen systems, antimicrobial access and stewardship, infection prevention and control, referral, and nutrition) delivered as a package to the populations where the residual burden is locked.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 儿童肺炎死亡率的历史性下降在很大程度上得益于针对b型流感嗜血杆菌（Hib）和肺炎链球菌的单病原体疫苗。然而，儿童肺炎死亡背后的病原体谱正在多样化：有效病原体数量从1990年的5.57上升至2023年的9.94，剩余负担正转向机会性病原体和医院相关病原体，而针对这些病原体尚无获批的儿童疫苗。本文探讨在这一转变过程中，应如何在单病原体干预与平台投资之间安排资源顺序。方法 我们分析了2023年全球疾病负担研究中0-19岁人群29种病原体导致的死亡数据（按超级区域划分），并结合WHO/UNICEF国家免疫覆盖率估计（WUENIC）中PCV3和Hib3的数据。我们在两种分母口径（26种和29种病原体口径）下量化了病原体谱转变，构建了按可干预性划分的份额矩阵，在明确的分类规则下将每种病原体归入主导干预渠道（疫苗可及、混合、平台敏感），将平台敏感死亡与透明计算的剩余疫苗可预防死亡情景估计进行比较，并按年龄趋向性和贫困锁定对病原体进行交叉分类。我们将平台干预锚定于经核实的已发表证据。结果 疫苗可预防组份额从54.0%降至40.2%，而机会性/医院组从18.1%升至23.1%（29种病原体口径，1990-2023年）。超级区域的疫苗覆盖率与病原体份额变化无显著关联（PCV3 Spearman rho = 0.108，p = 0.818；Hib3 rho = -0.036，p = 0.939），我们将这一零结果报告为简单覆盖率-负担相关性在区域层面不成立的证据，而非反对疫苗价值的证据。2023年，疫苗可及病原体导致441,410例死亡（45.7%，渠道包括COVID-19），混合类为126,926例（13.1%），平台敏感病原体为396,995例（41.1%）。平台敏感死亡是剩余疫苗可预防死亡情景估计（52,435-77,512）的2.9-5.1倍。14种可分类病原体中有9种属于贫困锁定、婴儿趋向性类别（480,922例死亡；Fisher OR = 9.0，p = 0.1758）。结论 随着病原体谱多样化且剩余死亡集中于平台敏感、贫困锁定、婴儿趋向性病原体，单病原体策略的边际价值下降。疫苗扩大推广仍是一个确定且规模可观的机会；下一增量边际资源应越来越多地资助平台能力（氧气系统、抗菌药物可及性与管理、感染预防与控制、转诊和营养），以综合包形式提供给剩余负担被锁定的人群。

papers.title: Multi-Ancestry Rare and Low-Frequency Variant Analysis Reveals Novel and Convergent Biological Pathways for Cannabis Use Disorder
papers.translated_title: 多祖先罕见和低频变异分析揭示了大麻使用障碍的新颖且趋同的生物学通路
papers.author: Peng, Q.
papers.summary: Large disparities in Cannabis Use Disorder (CUD) prevalence exist across U.S ethnic groups, yet genetic research has disproportionately focused on individuals of European descent. This study investigated the genetic architecture of CUD severity across three populations--American Indians, Mexican Americans, and European Americans--focusing on rare and low-frequency variants (minor allele frequency < 5%). CUD severity was measured using a validated composite of 20 cannabis-related life events, enhancing phenotypic resolution and power. In American Indians, ten genome-wide significant common variants were identified. Analyses of rare and low-frequency functional variants revealed novel, convergent biological pathways across ancestries. Notably, the arylsulfatases activation pathway was significantly associated with CUD severity in Mexican Americans and supported in American Indians, implicating sulfated lipids such as sphingolipids in CUD neurobiology. Related, in European Americans, the heparan sulfate degradation pathway--central to synaptic remodeling and extracellular matrix regulation--showed significant negative association with CUD severity. The integrin beta-1 cell surface interaction pathway, critical for neuronal adhesion and signaling, was uniquely enriched in Mexican Americans. Immune-related pathways, including shared involvement of a p38-gamma/delta MAPK signaling cascade, were supported across multiple cohorts. These findings highlight both ancestry-specific and shared mechanisms contributing to CUD severity, emphasizing the biological complexity of addiction. Importantly, these pathways represent potential therapeutic targets, suggesting that modulation of sulfated lipid metabolism and extracellular matrix remodeling may offer novel strategies for intervention. By integrating multi-ethnic cohorts and rare variant analyses, this study identifies underappreciated genetic contributors to CUD and underscores the importance of population-informed addiction genetics research.
papers.translated_summary: 大麻使用障碍（CUD）的患病率在美国不同族裔群体之间存在显著差异，然而遗传学研究却不成比例地集中于欧洲血统个体。本研究考察了三个群体——美洲印第安人、墨西哥裔美国人和欧洲裔美国人——中CUD严重程度的遗传架构，重点关注罕见和低频变异（次要等位基因频率<5%）。CUD严重程度通过一个经过验证的、由20项大麻相关生活事件组成的复合指标进行测量，从而提高了表型分辨率和统计效力。在美洲印第安人中，鉴定出十个全基因组显著常见变异。对罕见和低频功能变异的分析揭示了跨祖先的新颖且趋同的生物学通路。值得注意的是，芳基硫酸酯酶激活通路在墨西哥裔美国人中与CUD严重程度显著相关，并在美洲印第安人中得到支持，提示硫酸化脂质（如鞘脂）参与CUD的神经生物学。与此相关，在欧洲裔美国人中，硫酸乙酰肝素降解通路——对突触重塑和细胞外基质调控至关重要——与CUD严重程度呈显著负相关。整合素β-1细胞表面相互作用通路对神经元黏附和信号传导至关重要，在墨西哥裔美国人中呈现独特富集。免疫相关通路，包括共同涉及的p38-γ/δ MAPK信号级联，在多个队列中得到支持。这些发现凸显了贡献于CUD严重程度的祖先特异性和共享机制，强调了成瘾的生物学复杂性。重要的是，这些通路代表了潜在的治疗靶点，提示对硫酸化脂质代谢和细胞外基质重塑的调节可能提供新的干预策略。通过整合多族裔队列和罕见变异分析，本研究识别了CUD中被低估的遗传贡献因素，并强调了基于人群的成瘾遗传学研究的重要性。

papers.title: No Point Beating Around the Bedpan: Lessons from a Major Intra-Hospital NDM-Producing Escherichia coli Carriage Outbreak : a Mixed-Methods Study.
papers.translated_title: 不要拐弯抹角：一次医院内产NDM大肠杆菌携带重大暴发的教训：一项混合方法研究。
papers.author: Le Hir, A.
papers.summary: Antimicrobial resistance constitutes a major threat to global public health. Among emerging extensively drug-resistant bacteria (eXDR), carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales (CPE) expose hospitals to outbreaks through rapid dissemination, and to therapeutic limitations. Through a mixed epidemiological qualitative methods study, we report the most extensive CPE carriage outbreak known to date in France, which occurred at Hopital Europeen Marseille (HEM) between January and June2025. By the end of November 2024, the admission of an index patient returning from Senegal carrying an NDM-producing Escherichia coli led to an extensive transmission, despite adherence to national screen and isolate guidelines. Nearly 7,500 rectal screening tests identified 481 CPE carriers (including 343 NDM, 129 OXA-48-like and 9 other CPE), and 14 vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium carriers. This major outbreak prompted an extraordinary response involving clinical, technical and administrative teams within the institution. It highlighted operational limitations in current screening, cohorting and biocleaning strategies in the context of a hospital-wide outbreak. We describe the outbreak trajectory, the control measures implemented and provide a structured synthesis of lessons learned across organisational, scientific and policy domains.
papers.translated_summary: 抗菌药物耐药性对全球公共卫生构成重大威胁。在新出现的广泛耐药细菌（eXDR）中，产碳青霉烯酶肠杆菌目（CPE）通过快速传播使医院面临暴发风险，并带来治疗局限性。通过一项混合流行病学定性方法研究，我们报告了迄今为止法国已知规模最大的CPE携带暴发，该暴发于2025年1月至6月期间发生在马赛欧洲医院（HEM）。截至2024年11月底，一名从塞内加尔返回的指示病例入院，携带产NDM型大肠埃希菌，尽管遵循了国家筛查和隔离指南，仍导致了广泛传播。近7500次直肠筛查检测识别出481名CPE携带者（包括343例NDM、129例OXA-48样和9例其他CPE），以及14名耐万古霉素屎肠球菌携带者。此次重大暴发促使该机构临床、技术和行政团队采取了非常规应对措施。它凸显了在全院暴发背景下，当前筛查、分组和生物清洁策略在操作层面的局限性。我们描述了暴发轨迹、所实施的控制措施，并就组织、科学和政策领域所汲取的教训提供了结构化综合。

papers.title: How inherited variation shapes human disease trajectories
papers.translated_title: 遗传变异如何塑造人类疾病轨迹
papers.author: Urbut, S. M.
papers.summary: Although inherited variation is fixed at birth, its effects on health change with age and differ between common and rare variants. Here, we introduce Mendelnoulli, a longitudinal model that combines the age-dependent effects of polygenic and monogenic variation on health records, separating how much disease each individual accumulates overall from diseases to which they are prone. Mendelnoulli further allows polygenic and monogenic components to exert different influences on latent disease trajectories. We apply the model to 348 diseases, 36 polygenic scores, and 34 monogenic conditions across three biobanks and provide an atlas of the age-dependent effects of inherited variation on common human diseases. We show that polygenic effects change significantly with age, with Mendelnoulli improving held-out one-year discrimination for all 28 diseases tested compared with a model whose polygenic effects are constant over age (median AUC 0.95 vs 0.92). For individuals with no prior diagnoses, Mendelnoulli identified 8.6 more of every 100 new cases than that model, when each flagged the 5\% at highest risk. For genes with an established disease, Mendelnoulli selected that disease for 27 of 30 genes and ranked it first for 17 (7 expected by chance), and recovered known differences in timing, such as earlier breast cancer effects for BRCA1 than BRCA2 (peak 48 vs 66 years). Mendelnoulli provides a unified model of common and rare genetic influences on disease trajectories across the life course.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管遗传变异在出生时已固定，但其对健康的影响随年龄变化，并在常见变异与罕见变异之间有所不同。在此，我们介绍Mendelnoulli，一种纵向模型，该模型结合了多基因和单基因变异对健康记录的年龄依赖性效应，将每个个体总体上积累的疾病与其易患的疾病区分开来。Mendelnoulli进一步允许多基因和单基因组分对潜在疾病轨迹施加不同影响。我们将该模型应用于三个生物样本库中的348种疾病、36个多基因评分和34种单基因病症，并提供了遗传变异对常见人类疾病年龄依赖性效应的图谱。我们表明，多基因效应随年龄显著变化，与多基因效应不随年龄变化的模型相比，Mendelnoulli在所有28种测试疾病中均改善了留出的一年期判别能力（中位AUC 0.95 vs 0.92）。对于无既往诊断的个体，当每个模型均标记出风险最高的5%时，Mendelnoulli比该模型每100例新发病例中多识别出8.6例。对于已确立疾病的基因，Mendelnoulli在30个基因中为27个选择了该疾病，并将其中17个排在首位（随机预期为7个），并再现了已知的时间差异，例如BRCA1对乳腺癌的影响早于BRCA2（峰值48岁 vs 66岁）。Mendelnoulli提供了一个统一模型，涵盖常见和罕见遗传因素对整个生命历程中疾病轨迹的影响。
